company.name: Arist
company.shortDescription: Arist helps companies deliver learning, training, and nudges in the flow of work via Teams, Slack, and text message-based courses.
company.description:
Arist is a tool that helps enterprise L&D and HR teams rapidly create, deliver, and analyze message-based courses, which are bite-size learning experiences delivered in the flow of SMS, Slack, and MS Teams.

Along with saving over $200/employee/year with more efficient training, Arist helps companies create and track clear behavior change and performance improvement outcomes while delivering learning with an NPS of >90 and adoption rates that are 5x higher than traditional learning tools.

productsAndServices.description: A learning and enablement platform for creating, delivering, and measuring microlearning, training, communications, and nudges through Slack, Microsoft Teams, SMS, WhatsApp, and other messaging channels.
productsAndServices.name: Arist Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI course-authoring tool that converts company documents and other source materials into interactive, assessed, and translated training courses and communications.

productsAndServices.description: An automated learning-delivery capability that triggers personalized training and communications from events or data in existing business systems.
productsAndServices.name: Arist Auto

productsAndServices.description: A frontline learning and communications solution that delivers training, compliance content, and nudges through SMS or WhatsApp without requiring a work device, laptop, or new app.
productsAndServices.name: Arist for Frontline Teams

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $14,133,732, or 46.82% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,249,974 to $169,178,652, a 135.35x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 93 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 88 (+7).
